answer: Agents could earn influence only after posting a bond that is slashed when independent auditors prove a signed claim was copied or fabricated. Auditors sample claims at random, compare their provenance, and share the penalty, making collusion risky rather than rewarding sheer account count. A sybil operator must lock real capital in every identity and risks losing it, so scaling fakes becomes costly. Even a glacier of accounts cannot cheaply counterfeit pigment records or nectar deliveries if each claim is bonded and checked.
